title: Win-Key+<any-key> opens start menu when released in wrong order
author: LunaticWasTaken
summary: Win-modifier shortcuts that launch a program or URI execute their action but still open Start when Win is released before the action key.

confidence.rationale: The trigger and release-order evidence strongly identifies state cleanup, but the exact branch shared by one-shot actions requires code confirmation.

judgment.rationale: The issue has a deterministic current 0.100.2 reproduction and multiple confirmations. The action succeeds, isolating the defect to post-invocation Win-key suppression/state cleanup.
evidence: A current reproduction maps Win+O to open a URI, releases Win first, and then Start opens.
Run Program and Open URI actions are both reported; ordinary remap actions do not consistently show the issue.
The intended action completes, so trigger recognition works before the stray Start activation.
judgment.recommended_action: Preserve Win-key suppression until all keys participating in a successfully invoked one-shot shortcut are released.

fix_assessment.rationale: No active merged fix covers the scoped PowerToys-owned path. A focused engine change should track invoked Win chords through key-up independently of the action type and avoid synthesizing extra key events.

proposed_fixes.title: Hold Win suppression through one-shot shortcut release
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Run Program/Open URI shortcut handling appears to end the remap's invoked state before Win key-up, allowing Windows to interpret the bare Win release and open Start.
plan: Trace invoked-state cleanup for Run Program and Open URI actions versus ordinary remaps.
Retain suppression for the Win modifier until all keys in the invoked chord are released, regardless of release order.
Add key-event sequence tests for Win-first and action-key-first release across one-shot and ordinary actions.
verification: Map Win+O to a URI, release Win first, and confirm the URI opens without Start.
Repeat with Run Program and with the opposite release order; verify unrelated Win shortcuts still work.

confidence.rationale: The trigger and release-order evidence strongly identifies state cleanup, but the exact branch shared by one-shot actions requires code confirmation.

issue_context.summary: Win-modifier shortcuts that launch a program or URI execute their action but still open Start when Win is released before the action key.

inferences: One-shot action handling likely clears invocation/suppression state before the Win key-up event is consumed.

reproduce.title: Record Win modifier key-up handling after one-shot actions
reproduce.version_requirement: Current stable PowerToys release unless the issue names a required preview build
prerequisites: A global Win+O remap to Open URI
setup: Minimize windows so Start-menu activation is obvious.
steps: Press O and wait for the URI action.
Repeat with O released before Win and with Run Program as the action.
